verses.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਪੋਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਦਾ ਇੰਦਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਦੀ ਇਛ ਇਛੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: bal potaa prahilaadh dhaa i(n)dhar puree dhee ichh ichha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Son of Virochan and grand son of Prahalad, king Bali, had a desire of ruling the abode of Indr.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਉ ਇਕ ਇਕੋਤਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kar sa(n)pooran jag sau ik ikotar jag kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He had accomplished hundred yajns (burnt  offerings) and his other hudred yajns were in progress.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: baavan roopee aai kai garab nivaar bhagat udhara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Lord in the form of a dwarf came to remove his ego and thus liberated him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣ ਨੋ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਤਾਲਿ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: ei(n)dhraasan no paraharai jai pataal su hukamee ba(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He repudiated the throne of Indr and like an obedient servant went to the nether world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਛਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਛਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਰਵਾਨ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: bal chhal aap chhalaion dharavaaje dharavaan hova(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The Lord Himself got enamoured of Bali and had to stay as a door keeper of Bali.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਲੈ ਸਿਪ ਜਿਉ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਭੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh lai sip jiau motee chubhee maar suha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Bali, the king is like that shell which in the svati naksatr (a special star formation) receiving a drop and making it a pearl dives deep at the bottom of the sea.
The diamond heart of devotee Bali, cut by the diamond Lord was finally subsumed in Him.
